current_activity: in Mikawa's cruiser force at the Battle of Savo Island
notes: Cressman, 9 August 1942, names Yubari in the Savo night action at Ironbottom Sound. The JACAR 8th Fleet wartime log, C08030022500, names 夕張 (Yubari) with Chokai, Cruiser Division 6, Tenryu and Yunagi in the force that sortied (1600 on 7 August) and fought the ツラギ海峡夜戦 (Tulagi Strait night action), the same night battle Allied sources call the Battle of Savo Island, and reports US cruiser sinkings. Changed confidence from 0.5 to 0.7. The earlier confidence was 0.5, from Cressman only, because USSBS appendix 39 lists Tatsuta, not Yubari, in Cruiser Division 18. The updated confidence is 0.7, because two official families now agree on the unit, the battle day, and the named water (Cressman, us_navy_nhhc, Ironbottom Sound, 9 August; JACAR 8th Fleet log, jacar, Yubari in the Tulagi Strait night action). USSBS appendix 39 still lists Tatsuta, not Yubari; that disagreement is kept here and is not treated as a second agreeing family.
